verdict.rationale: AgentMail is documented as a hosted email API, with a hosted MCP server and managed inboxes. The only sign of self-hosting is one community comment that enterprise plans include a Bring Your Own Cloud option, which would put the pipeline in the customer's own cloud. Custom domains and IMAP/SMTP client access are adjacent controls and earn no credit. Missing for 10: first-party docs for self-hosting or BYOC deployment, details on which pipeline components run under customer control, any self-host option outside enterprise plans, and hands-on corroboration.
